name: Jaime Drozd
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Jaime Drozd is an attorney providing legal services covering Business Litigation, Class Action / Mass Torts: Defense and General Litigation.

Jaime Drozd, who practices law in Seattle, Washington, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2020 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at Boston University School of Law. She graduated in 2001. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 2002.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
